summary: Surveyed the full checkout (reservoir-sources/leanprover__lean-eval, an LLM theorem-proving benchmark): all 2094 .lean files (top dirs EvalTools/, LeanEval/, generated/, templates/, tests/lean/) plus non-Lean project files (README, lean-toolchain, LICENSE, .gitignore) that are not in any review unit's file list. generated/ holds 311 per-problem directories (one per famous theorem, e.g. fermat_last_theorem, poincare_3d_smooth, weil_conjectures, green_tao, plus a handful of harness self-test problems like def_hole_example/multi_hole_helpers_example), each with Challenge.lean (the formalized theorem statement, usually with `sorry`), Solution.lean and Submission.lean (wrapper/template also holding real theorem statements), Submission/Helpers.lean, and WorkspaceTest.lean; 208 of the 311 also carry a ChallengeDeps.lean with substantive supporting definitions (read generated/two_plus_two/*, generated/jordan_normal_form/ChallengeDeps.lean, generated/def_hole_example/Challenge.lean, generated/instance_hole_example/Challenge.lean, generated/multi_hole_helpers_example/Challenge.lean, generated/variable_binder_example/Challenge.lean, generated/ci_regenerate_main_check/Challenge.lean in full: every one holds a real theorem/def/instance/structure declaration, so none are in the no-declaration-keyword set). Ran a whole-word grep for theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom across the tree, finding 317 files with no such keyword, and read every one. 311 are generated/*/Submission/Helpers.lean; confirmed via md5sum that all 311 are byte-identical (53 bytes: `namespace Submission.Helpers` / `end Submission.Helpers`, no import, no declaration) -- a per-problem scaffold placeholder for a submitted proof's helper lemmas. This is a genuinely novel case with no matching hard-exclusion precedent (FD-001 is zero-byte files only; the file is not whitespace-only). Excluding it as an exact duplicate under FILTER-004 condition 2 would require retaining every original path as a provenance alias, which this review process's answer schema has no mechanism to guarantee, and each path is part of that theorem's otherwise-indexed problem bundle (the same navigational-completeness logic FILTER-007 applies to import aggregators), so per FILTER-002's default these stay retained. The remaining 6 no-declaration-keyword files are EvalTools.lean and 4 files under EvalTools/ (Generate.lean, Manifest.lean, Markers.lean, Subprocess.lean) plus LeanEval.lean, all read in full: each is a pure import (re-exporting from the external LeanEvalGenerator.Core dependency or aggregating the LeanEval/ subtree) plus an empty namespace wrapper -- a compatibility-hub pattern retained under FILTER-007 as navigation. The tests/lean/EvalToolsTests/*.lean files were read in part (headers) and confirmed to hold real `def`/test-harness declarations testing the eval tooling itself, not fixtures or dumps. No file in this source is a generated data table, LLM transcript dump, vendored copy, or binary/non-Lean artifact inside a review unit's scope.
